author: Nobody11221
quote: The characters are extremely boring. The missions are boring. 90% of the time you just watch cutscenes or do boring tasks or drive somewhere. It's not an open world game, it's very linear and you aren't allowed to do much other than the simple missions and interact with NPCs. The colors are all washed out and world feels very miserable. The 30fps is very bad, it's unplayable. The ending is very bad too and I don't think it's worth ever visiting again. GTA V, IV, SA had really great stories. It's made by people who clearly have no idea about those older titles, and if they do, it's even worse, because they clearly couldn't see what made them great. Zero stars from me. Total scam game and full of clearly biased critic reviews
